name: PID_Line_Tracer_V2
description: Improved dual-color-sensor PID line tracer using standard SPIKE-RT v0.2.0 APIs only. Startup mode menu: LEFT selects line tracing, RIGHT selects calibration, CENTER confirms. Calibration drives straight across a transverse black line from white to black to white and independently calibrates sensors B/F. Line tracing classifies centered, left-edge, right-edge, both-dark/crossing, and transition states. A six-state EKF estimates local along-track distance, cross-track error, heading error, yaw rate, gyro bias, and local path curvature using raw Hub IMU gyro Z, differential encoder yaw from motors A/E, and gated lateral observations from color sensors B/F. The EKF uses innovation gating and Joseph-form covariance updates; its estimated cross-track/heading error feeds the PID controller and its covariance adapts speed. Encoder-only odometry remains as a diagnostic reference. A future course-map hook can provide local curvature and target speed; no annual course is hardcoded and no map file is loaded yet. The line observation uses a provisional, tunable reflectance-to-mm scale. Standard APIs only; no driver modifications.
warning: Keep the robot stationary during the startup gyro-bias calibration. Place both color sensors on white and face the robot toward the transverse calibration line. The EKF starts each run with the assumption that the robot is approximately aligned with and centered on the local line. LINE_EKF_MM_PER_PERCENT is provisional and must be tuned after measuring actual sensor spacing, sensor height, and course line width. Wheel odometry and the local line-relative EKF are not global localization; along-track drift remains until a course map/landmark matcher is connected. Validate gyro sign, encoder sign, sensor response, EKF covariance, and PID tuning on the actual robot before high-speed use. The course-map interface is currently inactive.
